title: kate-core: wrap a quote after an even backslash run
summary: A quote after one backslash stays plain. A quote after two backslashes wraps. A quote after a letter stays plain. The test goes in the existing pair tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: pair.rs is a private module of fanout.rs. Its one test module is mod tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Add odd_backslashes_before. Count the backslash scalars immediately before at. Return true when that count is odd. Use let-else inside the walk: let Some(ch) = char_at(buf, index - 1) else { break; }; Do not match Option by hand. Replace the last line of quote_stays_plain with this exact return. Do not nest an if inside another if. return is_ascii_word(prev) || (prev is a backslash && odd_backslashes_before(buf, selection.min())); Write that as one boolean expression with || and &&. Do not touch plan_pair, is_type_over, is_opener, is_closer, is_quote, closer_for, one_scalar, char_before, or char_at. The existing test a_quote_after_a_backslash_stays_plain stays green. The test an_even_backslash_run_wraps_a_quote uses a buffer of two backslash scalars and a caret at Offset(2). plan_pair of a double quote returns Wrap with caret_after_open true. A buffer of one backslash and a caret at Offset(1) still returns Plain for a double quote. A buffer of the letter a and a caret at Offset(1) still returns Plain for a double quote. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: fanout::pair::tests::an_even_backslash_run_wraps_a_quote
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A quote after two backslashes returns Plain. After the change it returns Wrap with caret_after_open true. A quote after one backslash stays Plain. A quote after the letter a stays Plain.
